sources_verifiees: data-lake/SCHW/10Q/SCHW_2026-08-07.htm.gz (10-Q T2 2026, periode close le 30 juin 2026)

controles.affirmation: La SEC a retire en juin 2025 ses projets de regles sur la structure du marche actions, dont l'Order Competition Rule
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "On June 12, 2025, the SEC withdrew certain notices of proposed rulemaking issued between March 2022 and November 2023, which the Company had been evaluating. The withdrawn proposals included the December 2022 equity market structure rule proposals, 'Order Competition Rule' and 'Regulation Best Execution'."

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K rappelle que la remuneration du flux d'ordres fait partie du champ reglemente
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1 : "The regulations cover all aspects of the securities business, including, among other things, sales and trading practices, publication of research, margin lending, uses and safekeeping of clients' funds and securities, capital adequacy, recordkeeping and reporting, fee arrangements, order flow revenue from securities exchanges and market makers, disclosure to clients, fiduciary duties, and the conduct of directors, officers, and employees."

controles.affirmation: Le facteur de risque concurrentiel est intitule "hautement concurrentiel et caracterise par une concurrence agressive sur les prix", avec citation explicite de la hausse des taux servis sur les depots
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "Our industry is highly competitive and characterized by aggressive price competition." ; "Increased price competition from other financial services firms to attract clients, such as reduced commissions, higher deposit rates, reduced mutual fund or ETF expense ratios, or the increased use of incentives, could impact our results of operations and financial condition."

controles.affirmation: Verbatim sur le risque de reallocation du cash client et le recours a des financements plus chers
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "A significant reduction in our clients' allocation to cash, a change in the allocation of that cash, or a transfer of cash away from the Company, would likely reduce our income." ; "To help support these changes in client cash allocations, the Company extensively utilized higher-cost funding sources, which negatively impacted the Company's net income."

10-Q T2 2026, note 11 : un seul dossier nomme, Corrente Antitrust Litigation, deja regle : "The court granted final approval of the settlement on November 24, 2025" avec "non-monetary undertakings and payments of plaintiffs' attorneys' fees and costs in an amount that would be immaterial". Par ailleurs "Schwab believes it has strong defenses in all significant matters currently pending" et, pour tous les autres dossiers, "it does not appear reasonably possible that the outcome of any such matter would be material"

controles.affirmation: 0,19 % paye sur 246 346 M$ de depots bancaires moyens et 0,22 % sur 108 840 M$ de soldes de courtage au T2 2026, contre 0,55 % un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau Net Interest Revenue : Bank deposits 246,346 / 114 / 0.19% (contre 237,645 / 326 / 0.55%) ; Payables to brokerage clients 108,840 / 59 / 0.22%

controles.affirmation: AOCI a -10 575 M$, 9,6 Mds $ avant impot de perte figee sur les titres transferes AFS vers HTM, portefeuille HTM 130 568 M$ de cout amorti pour 121 206 M$ de juste valeur (ecart 9 993 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note 16 : "As of June 30, 2026, the total remaining unamortized loss on securities transferred from AFS to HTM included in AOCI was $7.3 billion net of tax effect ($9.6 billion pre-tax)". Note 4 : HTM cout amorti 130,568, gross unrealized losses 9,993, fair value 121,206. Bilan : AOCI (10,575)

controles.affirmation: Ratio de levier Tier 1 de 8,7 % contre ratio ajuste de 6,8 %, en baisse de 7,1 % fin 2025, bas de la fourchette d'objectif 6,75 %-7,00 %
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "As of June 30, 2026, our adjusted Tier 1 Leverage Ratio... was 6.8% for CSC (consolidated), decreasing from 7.1% as of year-end 2025 as a result of returns of excess capital and higher total Company assets" ; "The Company maintains a long-term operating objective for its consolidated adjusted Tier 1 Leverage Ratio of 6.75% - 7.00%" ; "the Company's consolidated Tier 1 Leverage Ratio at June 30, 2026 was 8.7%, down from 9.3% at year-end 2025"

controles.affirmation: RWA passes de 118 782 M$ a 150 030 M$ (+26 %) en six mois, fonds propres durs 36 081 M$ puis 36 538 M$, ratio CET1 de 30,4 % a 24,4 % ; rachats 3,4 Mds $ sur le semestre
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau Capital Management : Risk-Weighted Assets 150,030 (30/06/2026) contre 118,782 (31/12/2025) ; Common Equity Tier 1 Capital 36,538 contre 36,081 ; CET1/RWA 24.4%. "During the second quarter and first six months of 2026, the Company repurchased common stock of $1.0 billion and $3.4 billion, respectively"

controles.affirmation: Prets sur marge lies aux strategies long/short passes de 884 M$ (T2 2025) a 33 100 M$ (T2 2026), et exclus des actifs productifs a partir du T4 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note 1 du tableau Net Interest Revenue : "Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, margin loans and short credits related to client long/short strategies from which the Company earns a fixed net yield are excluded from interest-earning assets and funding sources... Average margin loans related to these client strategies totaled $33.1 billion and $23.7 billion for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, respectively, compared to $884 million and $562 million for the same periods in 2025"

controles.affirmation: Asymetrie de sensibilite : -5,3 % de revenu net d'interet pour -200 pdb contre +3,8 % pour +200 pdb, contre -15,0 % fin 2025 ; exposition EVE plus forte a la baisse
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Market Risk : (5.3)% / 3.8% au 30 juin 2026, (15.0)% au 31 decembre 2025 ; "Currently, the EVE exposure to rates increasing or decreasing in a similar magnitude shows that there is greater exposure to rates decreasing."

controles.affirmation: Depots bancaires moyens de 306 505 M$ en 2023 a 256 212 M$ en 2024 puis 238 088 M$ en 2025, soit -22 % ; part du cash dans les actifs clients a 9,0 % au 30 juin 2026 contre 9,9 % un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, tableau Net Interest Revenue : depots bancaires moyens 238,088 (2025) / 256,212 (2024) / 306,505 (2023). 10-Q T2 2026 : "Client cash as a percentage of client assets (at quarter end) 9.0% / 9.9%"

controles.affirmation: Trading 1 215 M$ dont 624 M$ d'order flow sur 7 072 M$ de revenus nets ; revenu net d'interet 3 357 M$
